title: Chiku Learns Patience
moral: Good things take time and patience helps them grow.

scenes.summary: Chiku is a curious chick who struggles with patience.
scenes.text:
Chiku the Chick Who Was Too Impatient

In a sunny farmyard, lived a tiny yellow chick named Chiku.

Chiku was curious and excited about everything.

But there was one problem…

Chiku was very impatient.

scenes.summary: Chiku wants seeds to grow immediately and refuses to wait.
scenes.text:
One day, Farmer Joe planted some seeds.

“What are those?” Chiku asked.

“They will grow into plants,” said Molly the Hen.

“When?” Chiku asked.

“In a few days,” Molly said.

“I want them now!” Chiku chirped.

scenes.summary: Chiku interferes with the seeds trying to make them grow faster.
scenes.text:
The next morning, Chiku ran to the field.

“Grow, grow!” he said.

But nothing had changed.

“I’ll help!” he said.

He poked the soil.

He scratched the ground.

“Oh!” he said.
scenes.image_prompt: chick scratching soil impatiently trying to help seeds grow, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Chiku learns that his impatience ruined the seeds.
scenes.text:
Chiku had disturbed the seeds.

“They won’t grow now,” Molly said gently.

Chiku felt sad.

“I just wanted them to grow faster,” he said.

Molly smiled.

“Some things take time,” she said.

“Let’s plant new seeds.”

scenes.summary: Chiku learns patience and enjoys watching the plants grow.
scenes.text:
This time, Chiku waited.

Day by day…

He watched quietly.

Soon, tiny green sprouts appeared!

“They’re growing!” Chiku cheered.

He waited a little more.

And the plants grew tall and strong.

Good things take time.

Patience helps things grow.

story:
Chiku the Chick Who Was Too Impatient

In a sunny farmyard, lived a tiny yellow chick named Chiku.

Chiku was curious and excited about everything.

But there was one problem…

Chiku was very impatient.

One day, Farmer Joe planted some seeds.

“What are those?” Chiku asked.

“They will grow into plants,” said Molly the Hen.

“When?” Chiku asked.

“In a few days,” Molly said.

“I want them now!” Chiku chirped.

The next morning, Chiku ran to the field.

“Grow, grow!” he said.

But nothing had changed.

“I’ll help!” he said.

He poked the soil.

He scratched the ground.

“Oh!” he said.

Chiku had disturbed the seeds.

“They won’t grow now,” Molly said gently.

Chiku felt sad.

“I just wanted them to grow faster,” he said.

Molly smiled.

“Some things take time,” she said.

“Let’s plant new seeds.”

This time, Chiku waited.

Day by day…

He watched quietly.

Soon, tiny green sprouts appeared!

“They’re growing!” Chiku cheered.

He waited a little more.

And the plants grew tall and strong.

Good things take time.

Patience helps things grow.

The End
